---
title: "The exercise"
subtitle: "Analyst no. 6"
---

This page sets out the exercise of the self-study route, task by task, with the tool in which each task is done. The [background page](../../cases/europeanisation/index.qmd) presents the original study, the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026) and the five reanalyses in full, and it is the place to start if you have not read it. Every task is done in the workspace that you download and open in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), on your own machine. The [browser lab](../../cases/europeanisation/lab.qmd), which runs the exercise in a browser tab with the data in place, holds every task as well, with hints and worked solutions, and carries the work if your installation fails. The lab and the workspace give the same numbers.

## The tasks {#the-tasks}

The route takes all five tasks: stage 1 takes Task 1, stage 3 Tasks 2 and 3, and stage 4 Tasks 4 and 5, and the page of each stage lists its steps. Each task below says what to do in the workspace and, where it differs, in the browser lab. Where a task asks the class to write something and send it together, write it into your report instead. Sending your results to the class chart is optional. Stage 5 then adds a project of your own, preregistered before it runs.

## Links {#links}

- [Slides](slides.qmd) – the full deck of the case study, read stage by stage with its speaker notes.
